name: av_ev_two_stop_race
source:
{ Two stop guards racing in the same step: the earlier crossing must win and
  the later one must not be reported at all. }
DYNAMIC ramp (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 6)
  der(Yv) = 1
  Yv(0) = 0
  EVENT late: Yv = 5.002 | rising -> stop
  EVENT early: Yv = 5 | rising -> stop
END
